name: Cirrus SR20 / SR22
summary: Composite four-to-five-seat single with a whole-airframe parachute; the best-selling piston single of the 2000s–2020s.

wings: Low, tapered composite wing with rounded tips
Drooped leading-edge cuff on the outer wing
engines: Single flat-six in a smooth composite cowling
fuselage: Fixed tricycle gear with wheel pants and a castering nose wheel
tail: Swept fin with conventional low horizontal tail

tellTales: Smooth composite low-wing single with fixed gear and wheel pants
Conventional low tail on a rivet-free airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The DA40 has a T-tail and a large bubble canopy; the Cirrus has a conventional low tail and side doors.
The Malibu/M-series has retractable gear and a pressurized cabin with small windows; the Cirrus has fixed gear and large windows.
The PA-28 is a riveted metal airplane with a single right door and a stabilator; the Cirrus is a smooth composite with doors on both sides.
The DA50 has a T-tail; the Cirrus has a conventional low tailplane.
The SR series has a parachute hatch on the rear deck; the Corvalis has no parachute cover and a smoother, more sloping windshield.
The SR20/22 has fixed gear and a parachute hatch on the roof; the Pipistrel Panthera has retractable gear and a long slender wing.
